protocol.scaler_fit: normal-only train1 and train2, sampled with configured seed
protocol.windowing: one-step process state and first difference; files are never concatenated across boundaries
protocol.explanation_label_use: attack labels are used only for post-hoc evaluation; capability groups, candidates, and counterfactual generation do not receive test labels

counterfactual.capability_model: Assumes the attacker can edit up to the configured number of observed process-prefix groups; groups and budget are fixed without test labels.
counterfactual.support_constraint_scope: Empirical distance to sampled training-normal records calibrated by a validation-normal q95 threshold; not a plant-physics or safety certificate.
counterfactual.search_scope: Greedy prefixes of grouped-ablation ranks and a bounded set of nearest training-normal donors; approximate search, no optimality guarantee.
